UC-1031.en: Clauseo makes an empty folder for this matter. Add papers to it any time.

UC-1033.en: Use a folder that already holds the papers. It stays where it is, and nothing is moved or copied.
UC-1033.note: Under Existing folder on New matter's first question. New.

UC-1034.note: The folder row's button in New matter's form once a folder is there (an existing folder picked, or where a new folder goes): picks another. In the dialog it replaces Choose folder… after a pick.

UC-1035.en: The folder stays where it is. Nothing is moved or copied.
UC-1035.note: Under the folder row of New matter's existing-folder form. New.

UC-1036.note: The folder row of New matter's new-folder form where the host has no place for new matters (no default location): Choose folder… picks where it goes. New.
